author: Eternalll
name: maven
short: Privileged access management: time-boxed role checkout with audit logging.
description: Keys aren't left in locks, why should it be any different for dangerous permissions? MAVEN is a privileged identity management (PAM) tool for Staff to check out privileged roles when needed.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, role IDs and checkout/expiry timestamps for active role checkouts. Records are removed when a checkout ends or when a data deletion request is made.
install_msg: Thanks for installing maven. Start with `[p]setmaven quickstart`, or browse all admin commands with `[p]help setmaven`.
